structure.body: One continuous closed solid capsule, lathed160 radial segments; radius0.78, body straight section1.24, rounded ends0.68 each.
structure.crossbands: Two broad silver front-wrapped annular sectors; centerY+0.32/-0.32, outer radius0.865, inner0.816, height0.36, beveled0.012.

material.qualification: Native glossy/anodized approximation. It does not equal photographic fine brushing in supplied source or separate generated cutout.

wordmark.customization: Only firstO. Boolean subtraction of original diagonal voice-notch polygon from font contours; native outline and3D share the resulting actual path. Ocurve flattened32samples perquadratic/cubic segment for deterministic boolean. Other8glyphs retain exactfontcurve paths.
wordmark.primary: Primary2D: OUT solidnavy#162760; SPOKEN solidNickel#A9AFBA; matchingfill/stroke, no glintband. Physical3D metal texture/highlights remain unchanged.

compatibility_aliases.gradient: Primary solid navy/silver; filename retained only.
compatibility_aliases.split: Same primary palette compatibility alias; not an extra distinctlook.

source: studio.html, wordmark-source.json and run/identity/build-wordmarks.py reproduce geometry and outlined lettering with already installed dependencies.
limits: Native reconstruction is authored from reference rather than pixel-identical geometry recovery.
